tasks.title: Add Redis service to docker-compose
tasks.description: Add a Redis 7 service with a healthcheck and wired volume to docker-compose.yml so a clean clone starts PostgreSQL and Redis together.

tasks.title: Add a Redis health probe and hard-fail mode
tasks.description: Expose a connectivity check on RedisCacheService and a strict mode used by security paths, so lockout and blacklist can fail closed instead of silently using the in-memory map.

tasks.title: Implement a Redis-backed token blacklist store
tasks.description: Add a store that records revoked refresh tokens with an expiry equal to the token remaining lifetime, and wire logout and family revocation to it.

tasks.title: Implement a Redis-backed login attempt counter
tasks.description: Add atomic increment-with-TTL counters for failed logins per account, exposing read, increment and clear operations.

tasks.title: Add Organization, Clinic and Membership Prisma models
tasks.description: Add organizations, clinics and user_memberships models with relations, uniqueness constraints and indexes. Membership carries role, status and links user, clinic and organization.

tasks.title: Add Invitation and AuditLog Prisma models
tasks.description: Add an invitations model (email, clinic, role, token hash, expiry, consumed at, invited by) and an append-only audit_logs model (actor, action, entity, entity id, before, after, clinic, organization, created at).

tasks.title: Generate and review the tenancy migration
tasks.description: Produce the Prisma migration for the new tables plus the data migration that maps every existing user into a default organization, clinic and SUPER_ADMIN membership, then retire the clinic-scoped role column from users.

tasks.title: Update the seed script for the tenancy hierarchy
tasks.description: Extend the idempotent seed so the four existing dev users become memberships of a seeded organization and clinic, keeping the existing login credentials working.

tasks.title: Add org_id, clinic_id and role to the access token
tasks.description: Extend the JWT payload and signing path so an access token always carries the active organization, clinic and role taken from the membership.

tasks.title: Resolve tenant scope from the token only
tasks.description: Add a request-scoped tenant context built exclusively from the verified token, and make the guard chain populate it, ignoring any clinic or organization identifier supplied in the body or query string.

tasks.title: Re-source the roles guard from membership
tasks.description: Change RolesGuard and the JWT strategy to read the active role from the membership carried in the token rather than from the user record.

tasks.title: Enforce memberships listing for the switcher
tasks.description: Add an endpoint that returns the caller active memberships with clinic name, organization name and per-clinic role.

tasks.title: Implement POST /auth/switch-workspace
tasks.description: Re-issue an access token scoped to the requested clinic when the caller holds an active membership there, and reject with 403 when they do not. Rotate the refresh token for the new scope.

tasks.title: Add the last-super-admin invariant
tasks.description: Refuse any membership change that would leave an organization with zero active SUPER_ADMIN members.

tasks.title: Implement transactional registration
tasks.description: Add a service operation that creates identity, organization, clinic and SUPER_ADMIN membership in one transaction, with the public route limited to creating new organizations only.

tasks.title: Implement create-additional-organization for signed-in users
tasks.description: Allow an authenticated user to create a new organization and first clinic, attaching a membership to the existing identity rather than creating a second account.

tasks.title: Implement the invitation issue endpoint
tasks.description: Allow a CLINIC_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN to invite an email with a role, generating a single-use hashed expiring token and revoking any earlier token for the same email and clinic.

tasks.title: Implement accept-invitation and password setting
tasks.description: Consume a valid invitation token, create or link the identity, set the password under the strength policy, grant exactly the invited membership, and mark the token consumed.

tasks.title: Add invitation and reset email templates
tasks.description: Extend the mail module with EN, AR and FR templates for invitations and password resets, escaping interpolated names, and include the expiring link.

tasks.title: Implement membership suspension and token invalidation
tasks.description: Allow a CLINIC_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN to suspend a membership, denying that clinic immediately and invalidating the user refresh tokens for it while leaving audit history intact.

tasks.title: Add a transactional audit writer
tasks.description: Write audit entries inside the same transaction as the mutation they describe, capturing actor, action, entity, entity id, before and after values, organization and clinic, so a rollback leaves no entry.

tasks.title: Apply auditing to auth and membership mutations
tasks.description: Wire the audit writer into user, membership, invitation, organization and clinic create, update and delete paths.

tasks.title: Add stable machine-readable auth error codes
tasks.description: Return a stable code plus a human-readable message for every auth failure so the front end can translate, including a distinguishable account-locked response.

tasks.title: Revoke sessions on password change and reset
tasks.description: Revoke all refresh tokens for the user after a successful password change or reset, and invalidate the Redis blacklist entries consistently.

tasks.title: Make lockout fail closed and non-enumerable
tasks.description: Integrate the Redis attempt counter into login, lock for fifteen minutes after five failures in ten minutes, and reject attempts with a retryable error when Redis is unavailable.

phases.name: Front end, security hardening and contract

tasks.title: Build the three-step registration wizard
tasks.description: Add the public registration UI with a stepper, per-step validation, Back navigation that preserves input, and a final summary. No partial persistence before submit.

tasks.title: Build the accept-invitation screen
tasks.description: Add /accept-invite that shows the clinic and role being accepted, sets the password, and converts an expired token into a request-a-new-invitation action.

tasks.title: Build the workspace switcher
tasks.description: Add a switcher listing every membership with the per-clinic role, plus the create-new-organization action, calling switch-workspace and re-scoping the client session.

tasks.title: Build the staff directory with invite and suspend
tasks.description: Add the active clinic staff directory showing email, role, status and last login, with invite and suspend actions behind confirm dialogs and skeletons while loading.

tasks.title: Localise and mirror every auth screen
tasks.description: Add EN, AR and FR strings for all auth screens and email templates, with RTL mirroring via logical CSS properties and no hard-coded user-facing text.

tasks.title: Apply per-endpoint rate limits and cookie policy
tasks.description: Add stricter throttling to login, register, forgot-password, reset-password and accept-invite, and set the refresh cookie Secure attribute from configuration while keeping Helmet, CORS and the validation pipe in force.

tasks.title: Document the auth contract in Swagger
tasks.description: Document every auth, invitation, membership and workspace-switch endpoint with request and response schemas, record the unversioned-path decision, and add new configuration keys to .env.example.

phases.name: Registration entry points and owner onboarding

tasks.title: Retire POST /auth/signup with 410 SIGNUP_RETIRED
tasks.description: Keep the route registered so it remains resolvable, but make it write nothing and respond 410 Gone with the stable code SIGNUP_RETIRED and a message pointing callers at POST /auth/register.

tasks.title: Remove the inactive-identity creation path
tasks.description: Delete the pending-account creation used only by the retired self-signup so no public path can leave an identity that waits for an approval nobody can grant.

tasks.title: Establish the owner session as registration completes
tasks.description: Make the registration completion land the creator in their new workspace already authenticated, reusing the existing login strategy so the access token and refresh cookie are issued once.

tasks.title: Replace the /signup screen with a redirect to /register
tasks.description: Remove the pending-approval screen from the backoffice router and redirect the legacy path to the three-step wizard.

tasks.title: Add the first-run workspace state for a new owner
tasks.description: Render a first-run state in the new workspace naming the next actions (invite staff, review clinic settings) instead of a generic empty dashboard.

tasks.title: Localise the new first-run and retirement strings
tasks.description: Add EN, AR and FR entries for the first-run guidance and the SIGNUP_RETIRED notice, with no hard-coded user-facing strings.
